transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because I’ve been experiencing some really strange things lately, like hearing voices that aren't actually there. I've also been dealing with an overwhelming, uncontrollable amount of energy and finding myself feeling extremely irritable.
Do you experience these voices or other unusual thoughts only during the periods when your energy is extremely high, or do they persist even when your mood is stable?

They actually persist even when my mood is stable and my energy is completely normal. There was a period of at least two weeks where I heard the voices and had those thoughts without any of that high energy. But yes, they also happen at the same time when I am in those high-energy phases.

latest_inference.note: Previously, the candidates were [Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features, Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type)]. Based on the patient's report that psychotic symptoms persist for at least two weeks in the absence of mood symptoms, the criteria for Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features are no longer met (as psychosis in that disorder must only occur during mood episodes). Therefore, Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type) is now the primary candidate.

I have narrowed the list to these two to further explore the temporal relationship between the mood and psychotic symptoms.
